folds.heading: ## Content reconciliation B304: original rounds1–7, remaining rounds open
folds.body:
Original lines1–662 were fully reviewed, through the end of round7. Original663–2200 remain open; this selected owner maintenance does not claim the rest read. ICX/ISR/IAU renames preserve source-local identity without colliding with standing CX/SR/AU families. The original F1–F5 findings and 53-control/Tab68/one-card/default-layout statements are historical source observations, not current defects. Current [entry rules](WORLD_ENTRY_RULES.md), [lead-life developer scope](LEAD_LIFE_RULES.md), [UI rules](UI_RULES.md) and PROJECT govern their use. Later intro rounds may qualify these early proposals and will be read before full closeout.

IF/CR/TE/CO/OP/XS retain useful readable creation, truthful labels, consequential choices, meaningful first actions and discovery-aware help. IF4's collapsed cosmetic More and CR2's all-visible columns are alternatives requiring a selected task/layout, not simultaneously mandatory. Classic-first OP3 and the old1366 target are historical; preserve useful independent panes and current desktop/text sizes. A known accessible function must not be hidden behind an invented tutorial milestone. A live first reveal differs from reconstruction on load, and optional hints must not replay rewards. First-choice tempo is a local proposal rather than a universal one-minute measure or a cap on long play.

A dormant promise, late choice, ordinary life and immediate fully functioning advantage remain possible source/world modes. CO1/IF9's day3/firstwin and mandatory costline wording do not force every faculty into delayed awakening or a disadvantage. Known costs are shown when they exist; a free source can remain free. A preview or sandbox does not touch the real save. Surprise must honestly distinguish actual supported variety from one available card without disclosing sealed/unmet family names or counts. Neither a visible field nor a background label proves its native effect. The player's creation preference and the character's actual soul/body/identity are different owners.

RW/RX/RP/UI/MI preserve unknown-world orientation and correlated starts. A world theme, common genre hint, discarded option, count, card silhouette, metadata label or seed can leak information even when its name is hidden. Expose only the actual known axis and supported preview. Low-spoiler entry can have breathing room and a useful first action while retaining selected harshness. Native language/knowledge is not uniform omniscience, an arrival is not uniform ignorance, and partial memory need not erase a real capability. Chosen/random/mixed axes, draft/free reroll/anti-repeat modes and preference weights remain proposals, not an automatically selected algorithm or lucky reward.

WC/WL/WF/WQ/WM and ISR/LY are a proposed composition boundary over actual content. Ordered compatible layers can reduce duplication; they are not the sole way to author a fixed source scene. Tags route modeled constraints rather than grant or forbid an outcome by label. A merged record still needs a real first action, body, place, stock, current source and command. Changing presentation wording does not implement missing mechanics. Missing-pack fallback may offer an explicit alternative, not silently replace a committed life or transfer its rewards. Preserve actual resolved identity/revision/provenance; a seed alone does not freeze later content. Current compatibility decision qualifies retired-record/links-outlive-pack guarantees, while current references remain internally consistent.

SG/LK/LG/LV/SX/SS distinguish actual shared-world seats, separate branches, carried objects, successor records, remembered clues and new lives. A portal/contract arrival can reuse known presentation while retaining its actual body/cargo/clock settlement; it does not reset a life because called a start. A player's bookmark, rumor or NPC acquaintance is a potential seed, not automatic eligibility or source truth. Copying/teaching/inheriting has the actual supported carrier and issuer/custody terms, not universal kinship amounts, forced debt or a balancing penalty. Undiscovered link IDs/status/counts in LV are not safe merely because opaque if the character does not know the link exists. Starting unlinked changes the offered premise without retroactively deleting an established separate person.

All24 SA rows were read. Their owned/partial/new labels describe design documentation at that snapshot, not working starts. Villain reputation, held role, prior body history and current intent stay separate. Reform, retirement, continued villainy, service or ordinary family life need not force atrocities or erase actual consequences. Minions/heroes need motives, knowledge, means and clocks rather than automatic opposition to a powerful player. Actor identity, old-body occupant fate, ordinary previous characters, real alternate selves, generated echoes, and current player control are distinct. OS1/OS4's automatic summarized-offscreen-life recommendation is qualified by current clock/absence policy and later light-cast direction, not a new default to invent years of life.

Round7's source-reader/catalog/lane request is preserved as historical coordination, not present authorization to read Lout volumes, launch agents or accept every RV/RO expansion. Script confidence, people noticing a change and prior-occupant paper trails need supported causal evidence; servants/family/enemies need not observe in the example's fixed order. The existing source/shelf/body/timeline owners retain their own partial read and qualification limits. No new start, panel, body, source reader, save, runtime change or current verification is supplied by this partial review.
